source.label: CAS Landslide study-area shapefiles (Zenodo)
source.method: centroid of each study-area polygon in 'study areas shp.zip' (one per region/sensor), reprojected to WGS84

note: 11 study-area polygons for the 9 regions (Hokkaido; Jiuzhai valley; Lombokt; Longxi River; Mengdong; Moxi town; Moxitaidi; Palu; Tiburon Peninsula (Planet); Tiburon Peninsula (Sentinel)t; wenchuan); the 20,865 chips are not individually georeferenced in a public index, so points are site centroids, not samples.
